input.headline: Treasury clearing deadline: firms onboarding to GSD now
input.what_happened: The SEC's Treasury clearing compliance date for eligible cash transactions is set for Dec 31, 2026.
input.so_what_front: Approaching deadlines can drive firms to rush GSD onboarding, raising demand on onboarding operations and Sponsored clearing volume.
input.so_now_what_front: Confirm onboarding operations teams are ready to handle demand surges or slowdowns.
input.action_reason: S is elevated at 4 with a hard deadline approaching; operations readiness check is the most direct near-term risk control.
